paper.title: Scientific Machine Learning Benchmarks
paper.authors: Jeyan Thiyagalingam, Mallikarjun Shankar, Geoffrey Fox et al.

thesis: In this paper, we describe our approach to the development of scientific machine learning benchmarks and review other approaches to benchmarking scientific machine learning.

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: How can the target scientific task be compared under fixed data and evaluation rules?

nodes.title: Freeze tasks and metrics
nodes.body: Historically, for modelling and simulation on HPC systems such problems have been addressed through benchmarking computer applications, algorithms, and architectures.

nodes.title: Evaluate reference systems
nodes.body: The breakthrough in Deep Learning neural networks has transformed the use of AI and machine learning technologies for the analysis of very large experimental datasets.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: Extending such a benchmarking approach and identifying metrics for the application of machine learning methods to scientific datasets is a new challenge for both scientists and computer scientists.
